CustomField.description: Displays the users current age in years based on a calculation of their Birth Date
CustomField.formula: IF( NOT( ISBLANK( Birthdate )) && NOT( Deceased__c ) , IF( DATE( 2000 , MONTH( Birthdate ) , DAY( Birthdate ) ) <= DATE( 2000 , MONTH( TODAY() ) , DAY( TODAY() ) ), YEAR (Today()) - YEAR ( Birthdate ), YEAR (Today()) - YEAR ( Birthdate ) -1 ), null)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Displays the users current age in years based on a calculation of their Birth Date
CustomField.label: Current Age
